purpose: Operational watch register for held and qualified external trend candidates.
boundary: A watch state records what to refresh and challenge. It does not promote a candidate or establish a company effect.

trends.cadence: monthly and on new remedy or implementation release
reversal_conditions: later comparable cases consistently reach usable recovery
implementation gap disappears across independent source families
trends.next_review: after the next comparable case panel is assembled

trends.cadence: quarterly or on a new comparable survey wave
reversal_conditions: later compatible waves show stable practical room despite pressure
higher-resource and constrained groups converge without support change
trends.next_review: after compatible denominator and participant-population reconciliation

trends.cadence: monthly or on a new adoption, control, or trust release
reversal_conditions: capability growth is accompanied by durable control and trust across independent measures
correction and exit rates decline without governance change
trends.next_review: after repeated task-level measures are identified

trends.cadence: monthly and on operation or disruption event
reversal_conditions: capacity claims repeatedly reach measured user receipt without material burden
local acceptance and reliability improve in later windows

trends.cadence: annually at the USDA release and on the next comparable Urban WBNS release
reversal_conditions: the next comparable release reverses the direction under a stable definition
the apparent persistence is explained by a denominator or methodology change
independent challenge measures no longer support the bounded pattern
trends.next_review: next comparable USDA and Urban release with definitions and methodology preserved
